title: Grateful Dead Live at Baltimore Civic Center on 1973-03-26
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> SEK'D Prodif Plus -> Samplitude Profesional v8.01 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording captures a monster March ’73 Baltimore show with a smoking Truckin’ > Weather Report Suite Prelude > Wharf Rat > Eyes > Morning Dew second‑set marathon.
ai_review.review: The Charlie Miller SBD transfer is crystal‑clear and perfectly balanced, delivering the full stereo hi‑fidelity experience fans crave. Musically the concert is a spring‑'73 masterpiece – a relaxed but focused first set followed by an unstoppable second set highlighted by the Truckin’ jam into the Weather Report Suite Prelude, a flawless Wharf Rat, and the epic Eyes → Morning Dew sequence. Jerry’s tone is immaculate, Phil’s bass sings, Keith’s keyboards sparkle, and the band’s energy stays sky‑high from start to finish.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 30 reviews overwhelmingly rate the show 5 stars, praising both performance and sound quality; recording is consistently described as crisp, stereo, and hi‑fidelity, while the musical content is called monster, smoking, and flawless.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Stereo Hi‑Fidelity SBD transfer; clean, balanced mix with no noted dropouts or noise. Reviewers repeatedly call it crisp, immaculate, and “Crisp!”

standout_songs: Truckin' > Weather Report Suite Prelude > Jam > Wharf Rat
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is relaxed yet focused, with solid renditions and a few less‑consistent moments; the second set is a seamless jam marathon that builds momentum from Truckin’ through Weather Report into Wharf Rat and culminates in an emotional Eyes → Morning Dew close.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as passionate, clean‑tone, “cooking” on the jams, with a superb solo bridge; his playing is called immaculate throughout.
band_member_comments.Phil: Repeatedly praised – “Phil really adding much to it”, “Phil sounds great”, “Phil finds groove in China Cat”; noted for powerful ending notes and bass bomb.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s keyboards are highlighted as “on big time”, providing great backing, two‑cents during jams, and sparkling fills throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann’s drumming is mentioned positively (“drums chugging along nicely”, “only 1 drummer” appreciated), with no complaints.
